profile.summary: airhorns is a mid-level JavaScript developer with deep expertise in Fastify, a high-performance Node.js web framework. Their contributions focus on Fastify's core systems—routing constraints, plugin integration, and debugging tools—demonstrating strong backend development skills. While primarily specialized in Fastify, their work also reflects proficiency in Node.js async patterns, semantic versioning, and community collaboration. Evidence suggests familiarity with modern JavaScript/TypeScript but lacks visibility in broader JavaScript ecosystems or frontend frameworks.
